gap_verdict.post_dengue: TRUE GAP — zero human post-acute/chronic-fatigue dengue omics; only acute-severity omics, cell-culture persistence models, autoimmune case reports, and one cross-pathogen antibody review.
gap_verdict.post_sars: NEAR-EMPTY — single survivor omics datapoint (Wu2017 lipid metabolome, 12-yr), phenotype = metabolic sequelae not fatigue-defined.
gap_verdict.qfs: PARTLY CLOSED — coherent single-group (Nijmegen/Radboud) cluster: cytokine/IFN-gamma, mitochondrial-peptide QFS-vs-CFS head-to-head, monocyte transcriptome, plus 2025 cross-PIFS immunological meta-analysis. Caveats: single-group provenance, no untargeted proteomics/metabolomics.
